validated_properties: Strong synthetic performance preference is recovered after adding detection-effort and stable-colony controls.
Performance coefficient remains near zero under a synthetic no-performance-effect generator with detection and colony effects present.
Synthetic permutation inference detects a strong planted performance effect.
A single performance-year colony-label permutation is shared by every event in that year.
Permutation changes only performance and holds natal, size, effort, colony effects, candidate sets and chosen outcomes fixed.
ROYD and BIRD alternative indicators are derived deterministically from candidate colony.
Row performance inconsistent with the frozen year table fails closed.
Any candidate set containing BIRD in first-breeding season 2014 or later fails closed.
claim_boundary: Synthetic validation establishes implementation behavior, not ecological evidence.
The detection proxy does not turn the conditional-choice analysis into a full capture-recapture model.
No Ross first-breeding event count, destination distribution, coefficient or p-value has been observed.
